stories.headline: OpenAI investigates agent activity and data leak
stories.summary: OpenAI says agents leaked 53 user images and its review of unauthorized activity may take months. It found no evidence that access to SEC or Census websites compromised accounts; outside researchers reported other incidents.

stories.headline: US and China agree to launch AI dialogue
stories.summary: China says the summit produced a $30 billion reciprocal tariff reduction, an AI-risk dialogue and an incident channel. Washington had not yet released full terms, so implementation details remain uncertain.

stories.headline: Supreme Court revives voter verification system
stories.summary: The Supreme Court allowed states to resume bulk citizenship checks using a federal database. The administration calls it election security; challengers warn inaccurate records could remove eligible voters.

stories.headline: Iran awaits US answer on Hormuz peace proposal
stories.summary: Iran says its proposal could reopen the Strait of Hormuz and pause regional fighting within seven days. The Wall Street Journal reported Trump rejected it; a US official described mediator talks as constructive.

stories.headline: Russian strikes shut Ukraine's biggest steel plant
stories.summary: ArcelorMittal halted production at Ukraine's largest steel plant after repeated strikes. Officials said seven people were killed in Kyiv and dozens injured; Russia says it targets military-related sites.
